text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. The once close-knit trio 
now clashes as the "Big Three" 
representing the umamusume world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will the winner be Special Week's fighting 
spirit, Grass Wonder's wisdom, or El 
Condor Pasa's ambition?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A dream match surpassing even that 
legendary Mainichi Okan. At the same time, 
this race is a 'runway of dreams' for El 
Condor Pasa."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A runway leading up to the world's skies. 
This decisive battle—is truly the ultimate 
touchstone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, I ran so, so much! Practically 
enough to wear down the track!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This might mean I won't be able to run 
with El-chan for a while. But...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If I run the best in Japan and beat you, 
El-chan, will you run with me again next 
year?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Spe-chan. Unless I surpass both 
of them, I won't be ready for the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely settle things with 
Spe-chan before I go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't even know myself. 
Whether I want to let you go, or whether I 
don't.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Still, beyond personal feelings, there is 
one certainty I hold firmly. And that is—”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume, I want to defeat you. 
With my own running—quietly honed to 
perfection."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass—that's the way.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's the Grass Wonder I know! The 
Umamusume I acknowledge as my greatest 
rival!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many things we can't 
understand, and can't share, if we're just 
best friends!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Lots and lots...! So, so, so very many! 
That's why!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. My apologies. How 
careless of me to say something that 
diminishes what we've built.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this come true, El. This 
once-in-a-lifetime encounter that nothing 
can replace.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pouring every single day I've spent with 
you— into this race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything that needed to be said has been 
said.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A three-way battle royale of tangled 
emotions. Only with a definitive 
conclusion—will the door to the world 
open.
